name: panel-controls
title: Panel Controls
description: Previous, Next and Close for a panel opened beside a list, pressed with K, J and Esc from anywhere on the page.

files.content:
'use client' import { ShortcutButton } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/shortcut-button' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' import type { ReactNode } from 'react' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' interface PanelControlsProps { /** Buttons of the panel's own before Previous, such as Open as a page. */ children?: ReactNode className?: string /** Closes the panel, from its button or Esc. The button carries `data-panel-close`, so a page that shows the panel on its own with a Back link can hide it and keep Esc. */ onClose?: () => void /** Opens the record below this one in the list, from its button or J. Leave out at the end. */ onNext?: () => void /** Opens the record above this one in the list, from its button or K. Leave out at the start. */ onPrevious?: () => void } /** Previous, Next and Close for a panel opened beside a list, on K, J and Esc. */ function PanelControls({ children, className, onClose, onNext, onPrevious, }: PanelControlsProps) { const moves = onNext !== undefined || onPrevious !== undefined return (
{children} {moves && ( <> )} {onClose && ( )}
) } export { PanelControls } export type { PanelControlsProps }
